local_current_pair.guard: Validate exact full closure, then re-read revision AND publication before owner creation. Throw PlacementDocumentChangedError on mismatch.

bounded_preintent_retry.guard: Only local PlacementDocumentChangedError and allowVersionRebase; max two attempts.

original_basis_capture.guard: Source and session document must match original exact verified pair/parent.

continuation.guard: Recover single owner and flush accepted basis; never continue from stale initial load. Multiple owners refuse.

accepted_adoption.guard: Canonical assembly must adopt accepted head/scope.

runtime_authority.guard: Original request/guards retained; Runtime handles conflicts, continuation and history. No old writer.

decision: No product patch. Do not drop the post-validation revision/publication comparison or reconstruct an unverified closure from the display read.

caller_preflight.fact: First load checks actual provider-local numeric configVersion and resolves source final video. Existing display read exposes no canonical closure.

closure_validation.fact: Full verified basis is loaded then validated before authoring; cannot manufacture child pins or assume empty closure.

freshness.fact: After asynchronous closure validation, compare both revision and publication with a newly observed head before durable owner/intent creation.

interface_gap.fact: LoadedTimeline has numeric configVersion/head but no canonicalDocument. TimelineCommandBasis has canonicalDocument and pair but no provider-local numeric configVersion.

controlling_mock.fact: Only loadTimelineCommandBasis exposes a full revision/publication pair and verified-shaped closure. loadTimeline has configVersion/revision only; loadAssetRegistry has neither head nor closure. Both timeline/basis loaders increment the immutable counter.

provider_implementation.fact: Basis reader assembles a history-pinned immutable closure, without a final live-head observation after validation. Display version is provider-local state; it cannot be inferred from revision IDs/history length or substituted with caller configVersion.
